title: Aston Villa sign Chelsea striker Nicolas Jackson for reported club record
english: Aston Villa has officially signed Senegalese forward Nicolas Jackson from Chelsea in a record-breaking deal reportedly worth 65 million pounds. Jackson joins the club on a five-year contract to fill the vacancy left by Ollie Watkins, who is departing for the Saudi Arabian side Al Hilal. The move reunites Jackson with manager Unai Emery, under whom he previously played during his time at Villarreal.
amharic: አስቶን ቪላ የሴኔጋሉን አጥቂ ኒኮላስ ጃክሰን ከቼልሲ በክለቡ ክብረ ወሰን በሆነ 65 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ ማስፈረሙን ይፋ አድርጓል። ጃክሰን ወደ ሳዑዲ አረቢያው አል ሂላል ለሚያመራው ኦሊ ዋትኪንስ ምትክ ሆኖ ለአምስት ዓመታት በቆየ ውል ተፈርሟል። ይህ ዝውውር ተጫዋቹን ቀደም ሲል በቪያሪያል አብረውት ከሰሩት አሰልጣኝ ኡናይ ኤመሪ ጋር እንደገና እንዲገናኝ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Kilabni Aston Villa weerartuu biyya Senegaal Niikolaas Jaakson kilabii Chelsii irraa paawundii miiliyoona 65 ta’uun kan galmeesse yoo ta’u, kunis rikoordii haaraa kilabichaa ta’eera. Jaakson kan gara kilabichaa dhufe kan Olhii Waatkiins gara kilabii Sa’udii Arebiyaa Al Hilaal deemu bakka bu’uufi. Mirkaneeffannaan kun Jaakson leenjisaa Unaa’ii Eemarii kan kanaan dura Viyaareelitti waliin hojjetan wajjin deebi’ee akka waliin hojjetu isa taasisa.

title: India and Pakistan are united in spending citizen lives like pocket change
english: Recent hospital fires in India and Pakistan have led to the tragic deaths of several newborns due to institutional negligence and poor safety standards. Despite these countries being intense rivals, both nations share a troubling pattern of failing to protect their most vulnerable citizens. Official responses have been repetitive, offering promises of investigations and compensation that fail to address the underlying lack of accountability.
amharic: በህንድ እና በፓኪስታን በሚገኙ የህክምና ተቋማት በተከሰቱ የእሳት አደጋዎች ሳቢያ በርካታ አራስ ህጻናት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እነዚህ ሁለት አገራት በፖለቲካዊ ጉዳዮች ተቀናቃኞች ቢሆኑም፣ ለዜጎቻቸው ደህንነት ትኩረት በመንፈግ ረገድ ግን ተመሳሳይ ችግር ይስተዋልባቸዋል። መንግስታት ለተፈጠረው አደጋ ምርመራ እና ካሳ እንደሚሰጡ ቢናገሩም፣ ተጠያቂነትን በማስፈን ረገድ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲከተሉት የቆዩት ደካማ አሰራር ለድግግሞሹ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Hospitaalota Indiyaa fi Paakistaan keessatti balaa ibiddaa uumameen daa'imman haaraa dhalatan hedduun lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Biyyoonni lamaan kun diina walii ta'us, dhimma nageenya lammiilee isaanii irratti garuu qindoomina qabu fakkaatuun gufataa jiru. Mootummoonni harka lafa ka'aa fi kaffaltii beenyaa waadaa seenan iyyuu, rakkoo bu'uuraa fi gaafatamummaa dhabuu isaanii furuu dadhabuun isaanii balaan kun irra deddeebi'ee akka uumamu taasiseera.

title: Six months into the Iran war, a new Gulf security architecture is emerging
english: Following six months of conflict with Iran, Gulf nations are evolving their approach to regional protection by moving beyond total reliance on the United States. These countries are now building a multifaceted security system that includes diverse partnerships to better safeguard critical infrastructure from drone and missile threats. While the U.S. remains a key ally, this new strategy creates a more layered and resilient defensive framework to manage ongoing regional instability.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር ከተደረገው የስድስት ወር ግጭት በኋላ፣ የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ለክልላዊ ጥበቃ በአሜሪካ ላይ ብቻ ከመመካት በመውጣት አዲሱን የደህንነት ስትራቴጂ እየቀረጹ ነው። እነዚህ አገራት በድሮን እና በሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች ላይ የሚደርሰውን የኢኮኖሚ እና የመሠረተ ልማት ጉዳት ለመከላከል የተለያዩ አዳዲስ አጋርነቶችን እየፈጠሩ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የአሜሪካ ሚና አሁንም አስፈላጊ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ አዲስ አካሄድ ለክልሉ ቀጣይነት ያለው ቀውስ የበለጠ አስተማማኝ እና የተደራጀ መከላከያ ለመገንባት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Iraan wajjin waraanni ji'a ja'aaf erga gaggeeffamee booda, biyyoonni Gulfii eegumsa naannichaa mirkaneeffachuuf guutummaatti Ameerikaa irratti qofa hirkachuu dhiisuun tarsiimoo isaanii jijjiirachaa jiru. Biyyoonni kun miidhaa miilaa fi qilleensa irraa infra-straktara isaanirra ga'u ittisuuf tumsa biyyoota garaa garaa waliin uummachaa jiru. Gaheen Ameerikaa ammallee kan jiru ta'us, tarsiimoon haaraan kun rakkoo naannichaa yeroo ammaa mudachaa jiru damdamachuuf eegumsa cimsamee fi faana qabate uumuuf gargaara.

title: Bernie Sanders, AOC join marchers in Washington to ‘defend the vote’
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Washington, D.C., to advocate for the protection of voting rights and civil liberties. The event coincided with the 63rd anniversary of Martin Luther King Jr.’s iconic 'I have a dream' speech. Notable political figures, including Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, participated in the march to show their support for the cause.
amharic: በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች የመራጮች መብት እና የዜጎች ነፃነት እንዲጠበቅ ለመጠየቅ በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ ተሰብስበው ነበር። ዝግጅቱ ማርቲን ሉተር ኪንግ ጁኒየር ታዋቂውን 'ህልም አለኝ' ንግግራቸውን ያደረጉበትን 63ኛ ዓመት የምስረታ በዓል ምክንያት በማድረግ የተከናወነ ነው። እንደ በርኒ ሳንደርስ እና አሌክሳንድሪያ ኦካሲዮ-ኮርቴዝ ያሉ ታዋቂ የፖለቲካ መሪዎች ለዚህ ዓላማ ድጋፋቸውን ለመግለጽ በሰልፉ ላይ ተሳትፈዋል።
oromo: Namoonni kumaan lakkaaʼaman mirgi sagalee kennuu fi mirgoonni namoomaa akka eegaman gaafachuuf magaalaa Waashingitanitti walgaʼaniiru. Sochiin kun ayyaana waggaa 63ffaa guyyaa Maartin Luuter King Juuniyeer haasaa 'abjuu qaba' jedhu itti taasisan waliin kan wal-simatuudha. Qaamoleen siyaasaa beekamoon akka Bernii Saanderis fi Aleksaandiraa Ookaasiyoo-Korteez duula kana deggeruuf hiriiricha irratti argamaniiru.

title: Iceland heads to the polls in knife-edge vote on restarting EU talks
english: Icelanders are voting in a crucial referendum to decide if the nation should resume membership negotiations with the European Union after a thirteen-year pause. Driven by rising living costs and regional security concerns, the country is currently divided on whether joining the bloc is the best path forward. Prime Minister Kristrun Frostadottir has pledged to respect the final outcome, which, if positive, would trigger years of formal talks followed by a final decision by the public.
amharic: የአይስላንድ ሕዝብ ከረጅም ጊዜ ቆይታ በኋላ የአገሪቱ የአውሮፓ ኅብረት አባልነት ድርድር ዳግም ይጀመር ወይስ አይጀመር በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ወሳኝ ምርጫ እያካሄዱ ነው። የኑሮ ውድነት እና የደኅንነት ስጋቶች አገሪቱን ለዚህ ውሳኔ ያበቁ ሲሆን፣ የአይስላንድ ሕዝብ በጉዳዩ ላይ ተከፋፍሏል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስትሩን ፍሮስታዶቲር የሕዝቡን ውሳኔ እንደሚያከብሩ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ድምፁ “አዎ” ከሆነ ለዓመታት የሚቆይ የድርድር ሂደት ይጀመራል ብለዋል።
oromo: Uummanni Isilaandi waggoota kudha sadii booda mariin miseensummaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa haa jalqabamu moo haa hafuu irratti murteessuuf sagalee kennuuf qophii ta'aniiru. Rakkoon gatii jireenyaa fi yaaddoon nageenyaa biyyaatti uumame marii kana akka barbaadan godheera. Ministirri Muummee Kristrun Frostadottir bu'aan sagalee kennamuu maaliyyuu yoo ta'e fudhatama akka argatu ibsanii, yoo 'eyyee' jedhame mariin waggoota hedduuf turu akka jalqabamu ibsaniiru.

title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
english: Severe flash floods recently hit the Nepal-Tibet border, causing significant destruction and many casualties. While dramatic footage of the disaster has circulated globally, Chinese state media and the internet have heavily restricted information and suppressed videos of the event. Despite rescue efforts by the government, the lack of survivor accounts or transparency highlights the strict information control Beijing maintains over the region.
amharic: በቅርቡ በኔፓል እና በቲቤት ድንበር አካባቢ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ ከፍተኛ ውድመት እና የሰው ህይወት መጥፋትን አስከትሏል። የአደጋው አስደንጋጭ ምስሎች በአለም ዙሪያ ቢሰራጩም፣ የቻይና መንግስት ሚዲያ እና የኢንተርኔት ተቋማት መረጃውን በመቆጣጠር ምስሎቹ እንዳይሰራጩ አግደዋል። መንግስት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወነ ቢሆንም፣ የጉዳቱ ዝርዝር መረጃዎች አለመውጣታቸው እና በስፍራው ያለው ጥብቅ የመረጃ ቁጥጥር አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Gudurri cimaan daangaa Neppaalii fi Tibbeeti gidduutti dhiheenya kana uumame miidhaa guddaa fi lubbuu namoota baay'ee galaafateera. Suuraawwan fi viidiyoowwan rifachiisoon balaa kanaa addunyaa irra kan faca'an ta'us, miidiyaaleen mootummaa Chaayinaa fi internetiin biyyattii odeeffannoo kana daangessuun viidiyoon akka hin mul'anne godhaniiru. Mootummaan hojiiwwan fayyisuu gaggeessaa kan jiru ta'us, odeeffannoo gahaa dhabuu fi to'annoo cimaa mootummaan naannichatti godhuun haala balichaa ifa gochuu dadhabsiiseera.

title: Trump says US has 'historic' deal to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
english: President Donald Trump has announced a significant agreement allowing the United States to access 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's oil reserves. This deal, managed through private partnerships, aims to boost American energy supplies, lower domestic fuel prices, and provide Venezuela with substantial economic investment. Officials from both nations believe this partnership will revitalize the Venezuelan economy while strengthening regional energy security.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከቬንዙዌላ 65 ቢሊየን በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ክምችት የማግኘት ታሪካዊ ስምምነት ላይ መድረሷን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ በግል አጋርነት የሚመራ ስምምነት የአሜሪካን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት በመጨመር የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ እና የቬንዙዌላን ኢኮኖሚ ለማነቃቃት ያለመ ነው። ሁለቱም ወገኖች ይህ ትብብር ለቬንዙዌላ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ዕድገት እና ለቀጣናዊ የኃይል ደህንነት ከፍተኛ አስተዋጽኦ እንደሚኖረው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonald Tiraamp, Ameerikaan kuusaa boba'aa biyyattii Veenzuweelaa keessaa biiliyoona 65 ta'u to'achuuf walii galtee seena qabeessa ta'e tokko irra gahuushee beeksisaniiru. Walii galteen dhuunfaa waliin ta'uun raawwatamu kun, dhiyeessa boba'aa Ameerikaa dabaluun gatii boba'aa hir'isuufi dinagdee Veenzuweelaa deebisanii ijaaruuf kan gargaaruudha. Qaamoleen mootummaa biyyoota lamaanii, walitti dhufeenyi kun dinagdee Veenzuweelaa fooyyessuufi tasgabbii anniisaa naannichaa mirkaneessuuf shoora guddaa akka qabu amanu.

title: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
english: Holly Ratchford, who managed the apartment complex where two 9/11 hijackers lived, has spoken publicly about her interactions with them and their associate, Omar al-Bayoumi. Bayoumi, who is now accused of assisting the hijackers, was a friendly neighbor who introduced the attackers to Ratchford years before the tragedy. This revelation comes as victims' families pursue a massive lawsuit against Saudi Arabia, alleging that Bayoumi played a key role in facilitating the terrorist plot.
amharic: የ9/11 አሸባሪዎች ይኖሩበት የነበረውን የአፓርትመንት ኮምፕሌክስ ያስተዳድሩ የነበሩት ሆሊ ራትችፎርድ፣ ስለ አሸባሪዎቹ እና ስለ ተባባሪያቸው ኦማር አል-ባዩሚ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በይፋ ተናግረዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሸባሪዎቹ መርዳት የተጠረጠረው አል-ባዩሚ፣ ከጥቃቱ ዓመታት በፊት ራትችፎርድን ከሁለቱ አሸባሪዎች ጋር ያስተዋወቀ ወዳጃዊ ጎረቤት ነበር። ይህ ምስክርነት የቀረበው የጥቃቱ ሰለባ ቤተሰቦች በሳውዲ አረቢያ መንግስት ላይ በከፈቱት ከፍተኛ የክስ ሂደት መካከል ነው።
oromo: Holi Raachfoordi, kan bulchaa mana jireenyaa shororkeessitoota 9/11 keessa jiraachaa turan taate, waa'ee isaanii fi gargaaraa isaanii Omaar al-Baayuumii irratti ibsa kenniteetti. Baayuumii, kan yeroo ammaa shororkeessitoota gargaaruun himatame, waggoota muraasa dura Raachfoordii fi shororkeessitoota kana walitti kan fige nama nagaa fakkaatu ture. title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
english: British political commentator Milo Yiannopoulos has been taken into custody by U.S. immigration authorities in Louisiana. He faces deportation after failing to attend a mandatory court hearing regarding his unauthorized stay in the United States. Officials stated that he overstayed his visa and will remain detained until his removal from the country is processed.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው የፖለቲካ ተንታኝ ሚሎ ያኖፑሎስ በአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት በሉዊዚያና በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ በአሜሪካ በመቆየታቸው ለቀረበባቸው የፍርድ ቤት ቀጠሮ ባለመገኘታቸው ከሀገር እንዲወጡ ትዕዛዝ ተላልፎባቸዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ እንደገለጹት ተንታኙ የቪዛ ጊዜያቸው ካለፈ በኋላ ሀገሪቱን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ በመቆየታቸው ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ በእስር ላይ ይቆያሉ።

title: Gunfire, blasts heard in several areas of Niger capital Niamey
english: Residents of Niamey, the capital of Niger, reported hearing intense gunfire and explosions early Saturday morning. The conflict was centered around key locations, including the presidential palace and the city's international airport. Local witnesses described ongoing fighting throughout several areas of the city.

oromo: Guyyaa Sanbataa ganama, magaalaa guddittii Niijar, Niyaamee keessatti dhukaasni cimaa fi dhohiinsi bakkeewwan hedduu keessatti dhaga'ameera. Waraanni kun mana mootummaa fi buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa magaalattii kanneen jedhamanitti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uun ibsameera. Ragaa baatonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni fi dhukaasni kun kutaa magaalattii garaa garaa keessatti ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Board of Peace’s Mladenov warns Gaza could be ‘gone for good’
english: Nikolay Mladenov from the Board of Peace has issued a stark warning that Gaza may face permanent destruction if urgent action is not taken. He emphasized that the region requires immediate reconstruction, the withdrawal of Israeli forces, and demilitarization to avoid a total collapse. Without these steps, he cautions that the deteriorating situation for Palestinians will likely trigger further severe security crises.
amharic: የሰላም ቦርድ ተወካይ ኒኮላይ ምላዴኖቭ ጋዛ በአስቸኳይ ካልተገነባችና የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ካልወጡ ለዘላለም ልትጠፋ እንደምትችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአካባቢው ያለው የፀጥታ ሁኔታ እያሽቆለቆለ በመሄዱ ለፍልስጤማውያን ያለው የኑሮ ሁኔታ ለሌላ ከፍተኛ የፀጥታ ቀውስ ሊዳርግ እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ቀውስ ለመቀልበስ የጋዛን አካባቢ ማረጋጋትና የውጭ ኃይሎችን ማስወጣት ወሳኝ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Bakka bu'aan Boordii Nageenyaa Nikolaay Mlaadeenov akka jedhutti, Gaza deebitee hin ijaaramtu yoo ta'e fi waraanni Israa'el hin baane taanaan guutummaatti baduu dandeessi. Haalli jireenyaa firoota Paalastayinii hammaachaa adeemuun isaa gara fuulduraatti rakkoo nageenyaa cimaa biraa uumuu danda'a jedhaniiru. Rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf nageenyaa fi tasgabbii buusuun akkasumas gargaarsa ariifachiisaa gochuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: US revises statements suggesting Chinese hackers attacked agencies
english: The US Department of Justice has clarified that while several major government agencies like NASA and the Senate were targeted by Chinese hackers, they were not all successfully breached. Officials updated a previous statement to distinguish between being a target and being an actual victim of a cyberattack. This correction aims to provide a more accurate account of the extent of the long-term cyber-espionage campaign.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር እንደ ናሳ እና ሴኔት ያሉ የመንግስት ተቋማት በቻይና ጠላፊዎች ኢላማ እንደተደረጉ ቢገልጽም፣ ሁሉም ተቋማት ግን አልተጠለፉም ብሏል። ባለስልጣናቱ ቀደም ሲል የተሰጠውን መግለጫ በማስተካከል፣ ኢላማ መደረግ እና መጠለፍ የተለያዩ እንደሆኑ አብራርተዋል። ይህ እርማት የረዥም ጊዜ የሳይበር ጥቃት ዘመቻውን መጠን በትክክል ለማሳወቅ የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Manni Maree Haqaa Ameerikaa dhaabbileen mootummaa akka NASA fi Senaatii qorattoota Chaayinaatiin xiyyeeffannoo keessa akka galan ibsee, garuu hundi isaanii akka hin cabne ifa godheera. Sirreeffamni kun duula hoggansa qilleensaa (cyber-espionage) dheeraa ture kanatti fayyadamuun odeeffannoo sirrii ta'e kennuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Iran war live: IRGC asserts strait control, US enforces blockade
english: Tensions between Iran and the United States have reached a critical point at the six-month mark of their conflict regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s Revolutionary Guard claims to have full control of the waterway, while the US insists its naval blockade is keeping the passage secure and open for transit. Both nations reject each other's narratives, and there are currently no diplomatic negotiations taking place to resolve the standoff.

Gamanni lamaanuu himannaa walii isaanii kan morman yoo ta'u, ammaaf rakkoo kana mariin furuuf yaalii tokko illee hin jiru.

title: Watch: Why rescuers fear new barrier lake could cause another Nepal-Tibet flood
english: Chinese authorities have issued an urgent warning regarding a new lake formed by a recent landslide near the Nepal-Tibet border. There is a significant danger that the lake's banks could collapse, potentially triggering another destructive flood in the region. This follows a previous flash flood caused by a mountain glacier collapse that recently devastated areas downstream.

title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
english: Norway is observing a period of mourning following the peaceful death of King Harald V at the age of 89. His son, King Haakon VIII, has officially ascended to the throne and pledged to uphold the royal family's dedication to the nation. Citizens and international leaders have gathered to pay their respects to the late monarch, who was widely celebrated for modernizing the monarchy and connecting deeply with the people.

title: Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king
english: Oslo Mayor Anne Lindboe has postponed her scheduled wedding ceremony following the passing of Norway's King Harald V. The mayor expressed deep respect for the late monarch, who was widely admired for his modernizing influence on the country. While the couple has been engaged for five years, they have not yet announced a new date for their celebration.
amharic: የኦስሎ ከንቲባ አን ሊንድቦ የኖርዌዩ ንጉሥ ሃራልድ 5ኛ በማረፋቸው ምክንያት ሊፈጽሙት የነበረውን የጋብቻ ሥነ-ሥርዓት ለሌላ ጊዜ አስተላልፈዋል። ከንቲባዋ ለሀገሪቱ ዘመናዊነት ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ ላደረጉት እና ለተወደዱት ንጉሥ ያላቸውን አክብሮት ገልጸዋል። ጥንዶቹ ለአምስት ዓመታት የቆየ የፍቅር ግንኙነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ለጋብቻቸው አዲስ ቀን እስካሁን አልወሰኑም።
oromo: Magari Oslon kan ta'an Anne Lindboe, du'a Mootii Norwey Harald V hordofee cidha isaanii dheeressaniiru. Kantiibitti kun mooticha biyyattii ammayyeessuu irratti gahee guddaa qabanif kabaja guddaa qaban ibsaniiru. Hiriyoonni kun waggaa shanf walii galtee kan turan yoo ta'u, guyyaa cidha isaanii haaraa garuu hanga ammaatti hin murteeffanne.

title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
english: Tensions have escalated in the Spanish territory of Ceuta following a mass migration event where thousands crossed the border from Morocco. Local residents have become increasingly hostile toward the remaining migrants, leading to violent confrontations, the destruction of temporary camps, and attempts to block humanitarian aid. While the Spanish government calls for calm, political divisions and public safety concerns continue to fuel unrest in the region.
amharic: ከሞሮኮ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ከገቡ በኋላ በከተማዋ ውጥረት ነግሷል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በቀሩት ስደተኞች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር መጠለያዎቻቸውን በእሳት ማቃጠል እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዳይደርስ ማገድን የመሳሰሉ ግጭቶች እየተፈጠሩ ነው። የስፔን መንግስት መረጋጋትን ቢጠይቅም፣ የፖለቲካ ክፍፍል እና የደህንነት ስጋቶች በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት አባብሰዉታል።
oromo: Godina Si’uuta (Ceuta) kan Ispeenitti baqattoonni kumaan lakka’aman Morookoo irraa erga seenanii booda jeequmsi fi walitti bu’iinsi guddaan uumameera. Jiraattonni naannichaa baqattoota hafan irratti humna fayyadamuudhaan qubannaa isaanii gubuu fi gargaarsi namoomaa akka hin geenye dhorkaa jiru. Mootummaan Ispeen tasgabbii akka bu’u gaafatus, garaagarummaan siyaasaa fi yaaddoon nageenyaa rakkoo kana daran hammaachiiseera.

title: Thieves steal 600-diamond necklace from Vienna museum in broad daylight
english: Two unidentified men stole a platinum necklace featuring over 600 diamonds from the Vienna Museum of Applied Arts in broad daylight. The suspects, one of whom reportedly carried a firearm, smashed a display case to take the piece, which was once owned by Egyptian royalty and is valued at over $4 million. Authorities are currently conducting an international manhunt and have released security camera footage to help identify the thieves.
amharic: ሁለት ያልታወቁ ግለሰቦች በቪየና የጥበብ ሙዚየም ውስጥ በታየ ኤግዚቢሽን ላይ ከ600 በላይ አልማዞች ያጌጠበትን የአንገት ሀብል በጠራራ ፀሐይ ሰርቀዋል። አንደኛው ተጠርጣሪ የጦር መሣሪያ እንደያዘ የተነገረ ሲሆን፣ ከ4 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ እንደሚገመት የሚታመነውንና የቀድሞ የግብፅ ንጉሳዊ ቤተሰብ ንብረት የነበረውን ሀብል የያዙበትን የመስታወት ሳጥን ሰብረው ጥለዋል። የኦስትሪያ ፖሊስ የጥበቃ ካሜራ ምስሎችን በመልቀቅ ተጠርጣሪዎቹን በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እያፈላለገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Namoonni lama adda baafamanii hin beekamne, magaalaa Veenaatti bakka kuusaa meeshaalee aartii keessatti garmalee gatii kan qabuufi alimaazii 600 ol of keessaa qabu kan gurguddatee seenaa mootummoota durii qabu hatanii jiru. Hattoonni kunneen keessaa tokko meeshaa waraanaa akka hidhate kan himame yoo ta'u, saanduqa isaa caccabsanii qabeenya dolaara miliyoona 4 ol baasu kana fudhatanii milqatanii jiru. Poolisiin Austiriyaa suuraa hattoota kanaa kaameeraa nageenyaa irraa argame gadi dhiisuun, isaan to'annoo jala oolchuuf sakatta'iinsa addunyaa irratti eegale jira.

title: Israeli strike kills three Palestinians in West Bank’s Jenin
english: Israeli forces conducted a drone strike in the West Bank city of Jenin, resulting in the deaths of three Palestinian men. The Israeli military identified one of the targets as a militant, while the Palestinian Islamic Jihad group claimed him as a senior member. Tensions remain high as Israeli leadership praised the operation, whereas Palestinian groups condemned the act and the reported interference with medical responders.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በዌስት ባንክ ጀኒን ከተማ ባደረሰው የድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ጥቃቱ ያነጣጠረው በታጣቂዎች ላይ ሲሆን፣ የፍልስጤም እስላማዊ ጂሃድ ቡድንም ከተገደሉት መካከል አንዱ ከፍተኛ አባል እንደነበረ አስታውቋል። የእስራኤል መንግስት ኦፕሬሽኑን ስኬታማ ሲል የገለጸው ሲሆን፣ የፍልስጤም ቡድኖች ግን ጥቃቱን በማውገዝ አምቡላንሶች ወደ ስፍራው እንዳይደርሱ ተከልክለዋል ሲሉ ከሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el magaalaa Jenin kan naannoo West Bank keessatti qilleensa irraa darbatameen haleellaa gaggeessaniin namoonni sadii du'aniiru. Mootummaan Israa'el haleellaa kana kan raawwate namoota haleellaa qopheessaa turan irratti akka ta'e ibse; gareen Islamic Jihad ammoo namoota ajjeefaman keessaa tokko miseensa isaanii cimaa akka ta'e mirkaneesse. Haleellaan kun gammoojjii keessatti mormii guddaa kan kaase yoo ta'u, gama tokkoon Israa'el milkaa'ina jechuun ergaa dabarsite, gama biraan ammoo gareewwan Falasxiin gocha kana balaaleffatanii jiru.

title: ‘Terrorist connection’ alleged in Trump’s Scotland golf course damage case
english: Seven individuals are facing criminal charges for causing damage to Donald Trump’s Turnberry golf resort in Scotland earlier this year. Prosecutors claim the incident was intensified by the group's alleged ties to Palestine Action, an organization officially designated as a terrorist group by the United Kingdom. Legal proceedings are currently underway regarding these serious accusations.
amharic: ሰባት ግለሰቦች በስኮትላንድ በሚገኘው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የጎልፍ መጫወቻ ሜዳ ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ ተከሰው ቀርበዋል። አቃቤ ህጉ ጉዳዩ ከፓለስታይን አክሽን (Palestine Action) ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ይህ ድርጅት በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም እንደ አሸባሪ ቡድን ተፈርጆ እንደሚገኝ አስታውቋል። በጉዳዩ ላይ ህጋዊ ክሶች ቀርበው ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Namoonni torba kanneen ta'an, iskotlaandiitti bakka tapha goolfii kan Donald Traamp irratti miidhaa geessisaniin himatamaniru. Abbaan alangaa akka ibsetti, gochi kun dhaabbata 'Palestine Action' jedhamu kan biyyi UK garee shororkeessaa jetee moggaastee wajjin walqabata. Himannaan kun seeraan ilaalamaa jira.

title: US judge denies injunction against Trump’s new birthright citizenship order
english: A U.S. judge has declined to immediately block President Trump's recent executive order aimed at limiting birthright citizenship. While the judge expressed concerns about the unprecedented nature of the order, she requested that the plaintiffs revise their legal filing before she reconsiders the request. This decision marks a temporary hurdle for advocacy groups fighting to preserve the constitutional right to citizenship for children born on U.S. soil.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ዳኛ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የትውልድ ዜግነትን ለመገደብ ያወጡትን አዲስ ትዕዛዝ በአስቸኳይ ለማገድ የቀረበለትን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ዳኛዋ በትዕዛዙ ላይ ስጋት ቢኖራቸውም፣ አመልካቾች ክሳቸውን አስተካክለው እንዲያቀርቡ መመሪያ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መሬት ላይ ለሚወለዱ ህጻናት የሚሰጠውን የዜግነት መብት ለማስከበር የሚታገሉ ቡድኖች ጊዜያዊ እንቅፋት ሆኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa tokko kan Yunaayitid Isteets, ajaja pirezidaant Traamp kan dhalootaan lammii ta'uu murteessu irratti baasan yeroof akka hin dhaabne murteessaniiru. Abbaan seerattii ajajichi haaraa fi tasa kan ta'e ta'uu isaa ibsanii, gareen himataa himannaa isaanii sirreessanii akka dhiyeessan gaafataniiru. Murteen kun mirga daa'imman biyyattii keessatti dhalatanii lammii ta'uu kabachiisuuf warra falman irratti gufuu yeroo gabaabaa uumee jira.

title: US Fed chair warns inflation progress insufficient, hints at rate hikes
english: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh signaled that the U.S. central bank may need to increase interest rates because current efforts to lower inflation have not met expectations. He emphasized that current economic conditions are not restrictive enough to hit the 2% inflation target, which remains significantly higher than desired. Market analysts now believe a rate hike could occur as early as September to ensure long-term price stability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ ሊቀመንበር ኬቨን ዋርሽ የዋጋ ግሽበትን ለመቆጣጠር የሚደረገው ጥረት አጥጋቢ ባለመሆኑ የወለድ ምጣኔ ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል። አሁን ያለው የኢኮኖሚ ሁኔታ የዋጋ ግሽበትን ወደ ተፈለገው የሁለት በመቶ ደረጃ ለማውረድ በቂ አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ ባንኩ የዋጋ ንረትን ለመግታት በሴፕቴምበር ወር ላይ የወለድ ምጣኔ ጭማሪ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Baankii Federaalaa Yuu-Esii Keebin Waarsh, carraaqqiin gatii dabuu (inflation) to'achuuf godhamaa jiru gahaa miti jechuun dhimmichaaf xiyyeeffannoo kennaniiru. Haalli dinagdee amma jiru gatiin dabuu kun gara dhibbeentaa lamaatti akka gadi bu'u taasisuuf humna akka hin qabne ibsuun, dhala baankii dabaluun akka barbaachisu eeraniiru. Kanaafuu, baankiin federaalaa gatii dabuu to'achuuf jecha ji'a Fulbaanaatti dhala baankii dabaluuf akka malu himameera.

title: Canadian economy recovers sharply in Q2 but shadow of US tariffs in future
english: Canada's economy grew by 3.3 percent in the second quarter, marking its strongest performance since 2023 due to increased exports and local spending. Despite this recovery, experts are concerned that new 50 percent tariffs imposed by the US will create significant economic uncertainty. While current growth shows the country is resilient, analysts expect future performance to slow down because of ongoing trade tensions.
amharic: የካናዳ ኢኮኖሚ በሁለተኛው ሩብ ዓመት በ3.3 በመቶ በማደግ ከ2023 ወዲህ ከፍተኛውን ዕድገት አስመዝግቧል። ይህ ዕድገት የተገኘው የወጪ ንግድ በመጨመሩ እና በአገር ውስጥ የፍጆታ ፍላጎት በማደጉ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የጣለችው አዲስ የ50 በመቶ የታሪፍ ዕገዳ ወደፊት ኢኮኖሚውን ፈታኝ እንደሚሆንበት ባለሙያዎች ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ይገኛል።
oromo: Diinagdeen Kaanaadaa waggaa kana keessa qooda lammaffaa keessa gara dhibbeentaa 3.3 guddachuu danda'eera; kunis kan ta'e gabaa alaa fi fayyadama keessoo biyyattii irraa argameedha. Ta'us, Ameerikaan meeshaalee Kaanaadaa irratti taarifii dhibbeentaa 50 ta'u erguun ishee fuulduraaf rakkoo fi gaaffii guddaa uumaa jira. Guddinni amma mul'ate jabaa ta'us, daldala biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumame kana hordofee guddinni diinagdee gara fuulduraa hir'achuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: 'High risk' of lake bursting and causing second flood, warns China
english: Chinese authorities have issued a warning that a lake formed by landslide debris near the Nepal-Tibet border is at a high risk of bursting. This danger follows a recent deadly flash flood caused by a glacier collapse, and further water accumulation is threatening to trigger new floods. Consequently, emergency services have been forced to pause search and rescue operations in the area due to the ongoing instability.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Chaayinaa daangaa Neppaal fi Tibbet gidduutti lafti sigiguudhaan haroon uumame tokko caccabuudhaan lolaa biroo kaasuuf yaaddoo guddaa akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru. Balaan kun lolaa gaaga'ama cimaa geessise booda kan dhufe yoo ta'u, bishaan haroo sana keessatti kuufamees lolaa biraa uumuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama. Sababa balaa kanaatiin, hojiiwwan barbaacha fi oolchiinsaa bakka sanaatti gaggeeffamaa turan yeroof dhaabbataniiru.

title: Trump administration illegally retaliated against Anthropic, judge rules
english: A federal judge has ruled that the Trump administration acted illegally by labeling the AI company Anthropic as a national security risk. The government took this action after Anthropic refused to let the military use its technology for autonomous weapons and surveillance programs. The court concluded that officials unfairly retaliated against the firm for its stance rather than addressing legitimate security concerns.
amharic: አንድ የፌደራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር አንትሮፒክ የተባለውን የአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኩባንያ ለሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት አለው በማለት የወሰደው እርምጃ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን ወስነዋል። መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው ኩባንያው ቴክኖሎጂውን ለጦር መሳሪያዎች እና ለክትትል ስራዎች እንዲውል ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኑ ነው። ፍርድ ቤቱ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ህጋዊ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ከመፍታት ይልቅ በኩባንያው ላይ የበቀል እርምጃ መውሰዳቸውን ገልጿል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa bulchiinsi Trump dhaabbata teeknoolojii Anthropic jedhamu irratti tarkaanfiin inni fudhate seeraan alaa ta'uu murteesseera. Mootummaan tarkaanfiicha kan fudhate, Anthropic teeknoolojii isaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi sakatta'iinsaaf akka hin oolchine erga hankaakee booda. Mana murtichaa akka ibsettti, qondaalonni mootummaa dhimma nageenyaa sababeffachuun dhaabbaticha irratti haaloo bahuu isaanii ibseera.

title: Tate brothers blast US jail conditions as they seek bail in UK extradition fight
english: Andrew and Tristan Tate appeared in a Florida court to request bail while challenging their extradition to the UK on human trafficking and rape charges. The brothers criticized their harsh jail conditions and insisted they are innocent, while government prosecutors argued they remain a significant flight risk due to their access to resources and multiple passports. A judge is expected to issue a written decision on their release at a later date as the UK prepares its formal extradition request.
amharic: አንድሪው እና ትሪስታን ቴይት በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የተከሰሱባቸውን የሰዎች ዝውውር እና አስገድዶ መድፈር ወንጀሎች ለመከላከል እንዲችሉ ከእስር ቤት እንዲፈቱ በፍሎሪዳ ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበዋል። ወንድማማቾቹ በእስር ቤቱ ውስጥ ያለውን አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ በመቃወም ንፁህ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ አቃቤ ህግ ግን የተለያዩ ፓስፖርቶች ስላሏቸው እና የገንዘብ አቅም ስላላቸው ሊያመልጡ ይችላሉ የሚል ክርክር አቅርበዋል። ዳኛው በጉዳዩ ላይ ውሳኔያቸውን በጽሁፍ ለመስጠት ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል።
oromo: Andrew fi Tristan Tate himannaa gudeeddii fi nama gurgurachuu UK keessatti irratti dhiyaateef mormii godhaniif akka gadhiifaman mana murtee Florida keessatti gaafataniiru. Obboloonni kunneen haala hidhaa jiru isaanitti ulfaate komatanii fi yakka raawwatne miti jedhanis, abbaan alangaa garuu isaan pasportii baay'ee fi qabeenya waan qabaniif ni baqatu jedhee mormuudhaan himate. Mana murtichis murtee isaa gara fuulduraatti barreeffamaan akka kennu ibsameera.

title: What we know after the big Grand Theft Auto 6 preview
english: Rockstar Games recently released a 26-minute preview of the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6, showcasing impressive realistic graphics and detailed environments in the fictional state of Leonida. The game centers on a Bonnie and Clyde-style duo named Jason and Lucia, allowing players to switch between the two characters during gameplay. While the footage highlighted improved visuals and character diversity, developers noted that player decisions will significantly influence the protagonists' relationship and the unfolding story.
amharic: ሮክስታር ጌምስ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲጠበቅ የነበረውን ግራንድ ተፍት አውቶ 6 (GTA 6) የ26 ደቂቃ ቅድመ እይታ ይፋ አድርጓል። ጨዋታው በሊዮኒዳ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ ተጫዋቾች ጄሰን እና ሉሲያ በተባሉ ሁለት ዋና ገጸ-ባህሪያት መካከል እየተቀያየሩ መጫወት ይችላሉ። ይህ አዲስ እትም እጅግ ዘመናዊ እና እውነተኛ የሚመስሉ ግራፊክስ እና አካባቢዎችን ያካተተ ሲሆን፣ የተጫዋቾች ውሳኔ በገጸ-ባህሪያቱ ግንኙነት እና በታሪኩ ሂደት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚኖረው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Rockstar Games tapha baay'ee eegamaa ture Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) irratti daqiiqaa 26 kan fudhatu agarsiisa ifa godheera. Taphi kun kan gaggeeffamu naannoo Leonida jedhamu keessatti yoo ta'u, taphattoonni akkaataa barbaadanitti Jason fi Lucia gidduutti jijjiiramanii taphachuu danda'u. Agarsiisichi warraaqsa gurguddaa fi qulqullina suuraa kan qabu yoo ta'u, murtoon taphattoonni fudhatan hariiroo fi adeemsa seenaa taphichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa akka qabaatu ibsameera.

title: Record drought grips Europe as rivers and crops dry up
english: Europe is currently experiencing a severe drought caused by extreme heat, leading to critically low water levels in its rivers. This environmental crisis is causing significant problems for the agricultural sector, commercial shipping routes, and the cooling systems of nuclear power plants. The situation highlights the growing impact of climate-related challenges on the continent's infrastructure and food security.
amharic: አውሮፓ በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ምክንያት በደረሰ ድርቅ ለከባድ ችግር ተጋልጣለች፣ ይህም በወንዞች ውስጥ ያለው የውሃ መጠን በታሪክ ዝቅተኛ እንዲሆን አድርጓል። ይህ የአየር ንብረት ቀውስ በግብርናው ዘርፍ፣ በትራንስፖርት እና በወንዞች ውሃን ለቅዝቃዜ በሚጠቀሙ የኑክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ነው። ሁኔታው በአህጉሪቱ መሠረተ ልማት እና የምግብ አቅርቦት ላይ የከፋ ተግዳሮቶችን እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Awurooppaan garmalee hoo'uu qilleensaan walqabatee gogiinsa hamaa keessa jirti, kunis sadarkaan bishaan laggeenii seenaa keessatti hanga hin mul'atinitti akka gadi bu'u godheera. Rakkoon kun damee qonnaa, geejiba galaanaafi tajaajila qabbaneessuu kan maashinoota anniisaa niwukilaraa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa jira. Haalli kun nageenya nyaataafi bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyyoota sanaa irratti balaa guddaa akka qabu ibsameera.

title: Six months of war between Iran, US leave Arab states facing tough questions
english: The ongoing six-month conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran has shifted into a long-term war of attrition with no clear winner in sight. Regional instability continues to threaten Gulf economies due to disrupted trade through the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing military uncertainty. Consequently, Arab nations are now seeking new defensive alliances and economic strategies to navigate a landscape where traditional partnerships no longer provide complete security.
amharic: በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ለስድስት ወራት ሲካሄድ የቆየው ግጭት ምንም ዓይነት አሸናፊ ሳይኖር ወደ ረጅም የአድካሚ ጦርነት ተቀይሯል። በሆርሙዝ የባህር ስትሬት ላይ ያለው የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ መስተጓጎል እና ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ አለመረጋጋት የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት የዐረብ አገራት ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የደህንነት ስምምነቶች ዋስትና እንደማይሰጡ በመገንዘብ አዳዲስ የመከላከያ ጥምረቶችን እና የኢኮኖሚ አማራጮችን እየፈለጉ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni ji'a ja'aaf Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru, injifattoonni ifaa osoo hin jiraatin gara waraana dheeraa fi wal-dadhabsiisuu tokkotti jijjiirameera. Miidhaan daandii galaana Hormuz irra ga'e fi tasgabbii dhabuun diinagdee biyyoota Gulf irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa jira. Haaluma kanaan, biyyoonni Arabaa gamtaan fi waliigalteen nageenyaa durii amansiisaa akka hin taane hubatanii, ittisa fi diinagdee isaanii cimsuuf michoota haaraa barbaadaa jiru.

title: Algeria residents mourn neighbours lost in wildfire aftermath
english: Communities in Algeria's Jijel province are grieving the loss of neighbors following a series of devastating wildfires. More than 150 fires ignited across the country in a single day, resulting in 12 deaths. While most of the fires have been extinguished, residents are now beginning the difficult process of assessing the destruction left behind.
amharic: በአልጄሪያ ጂጄል ግዛት የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች በተከሰተው አስከፊ የእሳት አደጋ ሕይወታቸውን ላጡ ጎረቤቶቻቸው በሐዘን ላይ ናቸው። በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ብቻ በመላ አገሪቱ ከ150 በላይ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች ተቀስቅሰው 12 ሰዎች ሞተዋል። አብዛኛው የእሳት አደጋ የተቆጣጠረ ቢሆንም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ በደረሰው የጉዳት መጠን ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Jiijel kan Aljeeriyaa jiraatan, ibidda bosonaa naannichatti ga'ee tureefi lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafate hordofee gaddi cimaan isaan mudateera. Guyyaa tokko keessatti ibiddoonni 150 ol kan ka'an yoo ta'u, namoonni 12 lubbuun darbeera. Ibiddoonni baay'een isaanii to'annaa jala kan oolan yoo ta'u, namoonni miidhaan dhaqqabe sakatta'uufi gadi fageenyaan qorachuu jalqabaniiru.

title: DRC begins vaccinating front-line healthcare workers against Ebola
english: The Democratic Republic of Congo has started vaccinating front-line health workers in Kisangani to combat a severe Ebola outbreak. Authorities are using an existing vaccine while clinical trials determine its effectiveness against the specific Bundibugyo strain, for which no cure currently exists. The virus is spreading rapidly across the Ituri region, exacerbated by regional instability and a high death toll that continues to rise.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ በኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ላይ ለመከላከል የጤና ባለሙያዎችን መከተብ ጀምራለች። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት እየተከሰተ ያለውን የቫይረስ አይነት ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል መድሃኒት ገና ባለመኖሩ፣ በሙከራ ደረጃ ላይ ያለ ክትባት እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛል። ወረርሽኙ በተለይም በኢቱሪ ግዛት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተዛመተ ሲሆን፣ የደህንነት ችግሮችና ሌሎች ተያያዥ ሁኔታዎች ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti kanatti fayyadamuun dhibee Ebola ittisuuf ogeeyyota fayyaa mudannoo jalqabaa irratti argaman wal’aansuuf duula talaalii eegaleera. Dhibeen kun gosa Bundibugyo waan ta’eef, talaaliin amma kennamaa jiru bu’aa qabaachuu isaa mirkaneessuuf qorannoon gaggeeffamaa jira. Dhibeewwan kun naannoo Iturii keessatti saffisaan babal'achaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, rakkoo nageenyaa fi haala rakkisaa biroo keessatti ittisuuf yaalameera.

title: Nepal’s mudslide wiped out areas of eastern China, army helps search
english: A massive landslide involving ice, mud, and rocks has triggered severe flash floods in the Tibetan border town of Gyirong, China. In response to the disaster, the Chinese military has deployed hundreds of soldiers to assist with urgent search and rescue efforts. Authorities are currently working to manage the aftermath of the collapse and locate those affected by the incident.

oromo: Mudhiin, cabbiin, fi dhagaan bakka guddaa rukutee lafa samiirraa gadi bu'uun, magaalaa Gyirong kan biyya Chaayinaa keessatti lolaa cimaa hordofsiiseera. Balaa kana hordofee, waraanni Chaayinaa hojii barbaachaafi baraarsaaf loltoota dhibbaan lakkaawaman gara naannichaa ergeera. Ammaaf, humnoonni waraanaa miidhaa ga'e xiinxaluu fi namoota balaa kanaan miidhaman barbaaduuf tattaaffii godhaa jiru.

title: Trump posts picture showing Hormuz Strait as a US territory
english: Donald Trump recently shared an image on social media claiming the Strait of Hormuz belongs to the United States. He has made several similar statements lately, insisting that his administration oversees this vital waterway and maintains a blockade on Iranian ports. No official explanation or further details were provided regarding these provocative posts.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝ የባህር ጠባብ የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሆነ የሚያሳይ ምስል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለጥፈዋል። ትራምፕ በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ንግግር በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር እንዳለ እና የኢራን ወደቦችን ዘግተው እንደሚገኙ ሲገልጹ ነበር። ይህንን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ በድጋሚ በማንሳት በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ምስሉን ቢለጥፉም ተጨማሪ ማብራሪያ ግን አልሰጡም።
oromo: Donald Tiraamp miidiyaa hawaasummaa isaarratti bifa suuraa qabuun dhiphina galaanaa Hormuuz kan Ameerikaati jechuun ibseera. Innis akkaataa itti bulmaata isaatiin galaanni kun harka Ameerikaa jala akka jiruufi buufataaleen Iiraan akka cufaman himaa tureera. Tiraamp waa'ee kanaa ibsa dabalataa osoo hin kennin irra deddeebi'ee kanuma ibsaa jira.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions are rising as the Israeli military conducted strikes and house searches in Syria while the US maintains a strict economic blockade on Iran. Iranian officials have threatened to target American economic interests if the maritime restrictions are not lifted. Meanwhile, the US insists that its naval operations in the Strait of Hormuz are focused on keeping key shipping lanes safe and active.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሶሪያ ላይ ጥቃት እና የቤት ፍተሻዎችን ሲያካሂዱ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን ኢኮኖሚያዊ ማዕቀብ አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ማዕቀቡ ካልተነሳ በአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ጥቅሞች ላይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስፈራርተዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ አሜሪካ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ የምታደርገው እንቅስቃሴ የንግድ መርከቦችን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el Soriyaa keessatti haleellaa fi sakatta'iinsa manneenii gaggeessaa jiru, gama biraatiin ammoo Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee Iran irratti jabaachaa jirti. Aangewwonni Iran dhiibbaan diinagdee kun yoo hin kaane, faayidaa diinagdee Ameerikaa irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Ameerikaan humnoonni ishee galaana Hormuz keessatti socho'an kun nageenya dooniiwwan daldalaa eeguuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: US Treasury Secretary says blockade on Iran will 'crush failing Iranian economy'
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that a new blockade and economic operation are targeting Iran to cripple its struggling economy. He claimed that the US has successfully diverted 130 million barrels of oil through the Gulf in the last two weeks, effectively cutting off Iran's exports. This strategy is intended to intensify pressure on the Iranian government by isolating its primary revenue source.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት በአዲሱ እገዳ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ዘመቻ አማካኝነት የኢራንን ደካማ ኢኮኖሚ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመጉዳት እቅድ እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ 130 ሚሊዮን በርሜል ነዳጅ በፋርስ ባሕረ ሰላጤ በኩል እንዲተላለፍ በማድረግ የኢራንን የነዳጅ ንግድ ማስተጓጎላቸውን ተናግረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የኢራንን ገቢ በመቁረጥ በሀገሪቱ መንግስት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqaa Ameerikaa Iskoot Beseenti, addunyaan dhiibbaa diinagdee haarawaa irratti fudhachuun diinagdee Iraan kan kufuuf jedhu miidhuuf akka karoorfatan ibsan. Ameerikaan torban lamaan darban keessa boba'aa miliyoona 130 ta'u galaana keessa dabarsuun gurgurtaa boba'aa Iraan dhaabuu ishee ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun maddii galii guddaa Iraan ta'e cufuun mootummaa biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Shipping traffic via Hormuz Strait dips to five on Thursday
english: Shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz saw a significant decline on Thursday, with only five commodity vessels passing through. This number is notably lower than the 17 ships recorded the previous day and falls well below the recent ten-day average of 15. The small group of transiting vessels included two medium-range tankers and one large gas carrier.

Guyyaa sana dooniiwwan gurguddoo shan qofa kan darban yoo ta'u, kunis guyyaa dura lakkoofsa 17 fi giddu-galeessa guyyoota kurnan darban keessatti mul'achaa ture 15 irraa kan gadi bu'e dha. Dooniiwwan darban kana keessaa tankaroota giddu-galeessaa lamaa fi doonii gaazii guddaa tokkotu argama.

title: Turkey allows visa exemptions to Syrian diplomatic passport holders
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has officially approved a visa exemption for Syrian citizens who hold diplomatic passports. Under this new policy, these individuals can travel to Turkey for tourism or transit purposes without a visa for up to 90 days within a six-month window. This decision was formally announced in the country's official gazette on August 27.

oromo: Pireezidantiin Turkey Recep Tayyip Erdogan lammiilee Suuriyaa paspoortii dippiloomaasii qabanuf viizaa malee biyyattii seenuu akka danda'an hayyamaniiru. Murteen kun guyyaa Hagayya 27 gaazexaa mootummaa biyyattii irratti ifatti beekameera.

title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
english: Ratko Mladić, the former Bosnian Serb military leader convicted of genocide and war crimes, has passed away in a UN prison at age 84. Often called the Butcher of Bosnia, he was serving a life sentence for his role in the 1990s ethnic cleansing campaigns, including the Srebrenica massacre and the siege of Sarajevo. The UN court is currently investigating the circumstances of his death after his health had significantly declined in recent years.
amharic: በዘር ማጥፋትና በጦር ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ተብሎ የተፈረደበት የቦስኒያ ሰርብ ወታደራዊ መሪ ራትኮ ምላዲች በ84 ዓመቱ በተባበሩት መንግስታት እስር ቤት ውስጥ ህይወቱ አልፏል። የቦስኒያ ቅፅል ስም ያለው ሰው በ1990ዎቹ በተካሄደው የዘር ማፅዳት ዘመቻ፣ በስሬብሬኒካ የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ እና በሳራዬቮ ከበባ ባለው ሚና የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ተፈርዶበት ነበር። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ፍርድ ቤት በቅርብ ዓመታት ጤንነቱ በእጅጉ ተዳክሞ የነበረው የምላዲችን ሞት ሁኔታ በመመርመር ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Serbiyaa Bosniyaa duraanii fi yakka sanyii balleessuu fi yakka waraanaatiin himatamee ture Raatkoo Mlaadiich, umrii isaa waggaa 84tti mana hidhaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti du’e. Namni 'Butcher of Bosnia' jedhamuun beekamu kun, waggoota 1990 keessa sanyii qulqulleessuu fi ajjeechaa Srebreniikaa dabalatee yakka raawwateef hidhaa umrii guutuu itti muramee ture. Mana hidhaatti fayyaan isaa gadi bu'aa kan ture Mlaadiich du'uu isaa hordofee, mana murtii mootummoota gamtoomaniitti qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira.

title: Jury deliberating in trial of Lindsay Clancy, US woman accused of killing her children
english: A Massachusetts jury is currently deciding the fate of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three young children. While she admits to the killings, her defense team argues she was suffering from postpartum psychosis, while prosecutors claim the murders were premeditated. The jury must now choose between several verdicts, including first-degree murder, lesser charges, or finding her not guilty due to insanity, which would result in psychiatric confinement.
amharic: ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደል የተከሰሰችው አሜሪካዊቷ ሊንሳይ ክላንሲ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ በዳኞች እጅ ገብቷል። ተከሳሡ ግድያውን እንደፈጸመች ብትቀበልም፣ ጠበቆቿ ድርጊቱን የፈጸመችው በወሊድ ጊዜ በሚከሰት የአእምሮ መታወክ (postpartum psychosis) እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ። አቃቤ ህግ ግን ግድያው አስቀድሞ የታቀደ መሆኑን ሲገልጹ፣ ዳኞቹ እንደ ወንጀሉ ክብደት የጥፋተኝነት ፍርድ ወይም በአእምሮ ህመም ምክንያት ንፁህ የመባል ውሳኔ የመስጠት ስልጣን አላቸው።
oromo: Maatiin abbaa seeraa Massachusetts gubbaatti, dubartii ijoollee ishee sadii ajjeeste jedhamtee shakkamtuu Lindsay Clancy irratti murtoo kennuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Clancy gocha kana raawwachuu ishee kan amaltu ta'us, gareen abukaatoo ishee rakkoo fayyaa sammuu kan da'umsa booda ishee mudateen kan raawwatte akka ta'e dubbatu. Gamtaan abbaa seeraa kun ajjechaan kun kan karoorfame moo sababa dhukkubaan akka ta'e gargar baasuudhaan, hidhaa jabaa ykn gara hospitaala sammuu erguuf murtoo kennuutu irraa eegama.

title: Barcelona scraps Spain World Cup tribute amid fans’ Catalan flag support
english: FC Barcelona canceled a planned tribute for its players who won the World Cup with Spain after a fan was detained for displaying a Catalan pro-independence flag at a previous match. The club expressed solidarity with its supporters by defending the right to display the flag as a form of free expression. In response, fans at the recent home game filled the stadium with thousands of these independence flags to show their political stance.

title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say

title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
english: Massive floods and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border have resulted in significant casualties and left many people missing, prompting urgent rescue operations. While initially thought to be caused by an earthquake, experts now confirm the disaster was triggered by a catastrophic glacial collapse that sent dangerous debris downstream. Scientists suggest that climate change is destabilizing the region by melting glaciers and thawing permafrost, which increases the likelihood of such deadly events.

title: Norway's royal family gathers at King Harald's bedside as his condition worsens
english: King Harald V of Norway is currently in critical condition at an Oslo hospital while receiving treatment for a rare blood disorder. His family, including Queen Sonja and Crown Prince Haakon, have paused their official duties to remain by his side. As the 89-year-old monarch faces this serious health challenge, the Prime Minister and the Norwegian public have expressed their solidarity and concern.
